summary: @servicetitan/carto-rn-kit preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (node setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it executable, then invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. setup.mjs performs libc/OS fingerprinting (ldd --version, /etc/os-release) to select the correct Bun variant (musl-baseline vs baseline) so the payload runs reliably on both glibc and Alpine/musl hosts (including CI containers). math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line JavaScript file using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation, hex-named identifiers, and a shuffled-array decoder (WV8StW) — its contents are not human-readable. The package is published under a vendor-scoped name presenting as a React Native UI component kit (Button, Card, Dialog, etc.), a scope for which downloading a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundled blob has no legitimate purpose. The Bun runtime is used specifically to execute code outside Node's resolution and inspection path, and the payload is delivered via an npm lifecycle hook that fires on default `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
